name: Honey Mustard Lamb Chops with Mushrooms & Green Beans

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the mushrooms and beans. Thinly slice the mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
0.68 kg green beans

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic and place in a small bowl; add Dijon, honey, vinegar, salt, and pepper and whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
⅓ cup Dijon mustard
3 tbsp honey
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
In a separate bowl, toss lamb chops in half the honey mustard sauce. Reserve the remaining, untouched sauce for later.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Place the lamb chops in the skillet; cook until they are nicely seared and cooked to your desired doneness, 3-4 minutes per side. Once done, transfer the chops to a plate and let them rest for 5 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
Return the skillet to the heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms soften, 4-5 min.
Meanwhile, trim and discard the ends of the green beans.
Add beans to the skillet and continue to cook until beans are tender crisp, 2-3 min. If necessary remove mushrooms and set aside before adding beans.
Add remaining, untouched sauce to the skillet with the veggies and cook until heated through, stirring frequently, 1 min more.
To serve, divide lamb chops between plates, arrange veggies on the side drizzling with any sauce remaining in the pan. Enjoy!
